insight: Three revolutions at 45 rpm are four seconds of one continuous, inward-moving spiral. Multiple recuts on an identical groove are not recommended.

guardrails: heater circuit isolated from recording-head amplifier
normally-off heater with current limit, fuse and independent thermal cutoff
raise head and power-down on loss of spindle index
no processing reclaimed PVC in maker apparatus

experiment.phaseA: Three independent sample regions or blanks, same audio clip and heat OFF; compare only calibrated drive level, not repeated machining of same groove.
experiment.phaseB: Only after phase A and independent material/electrical review, compare heater OFF vs an independently calibrated LOW heater on new blanks at a FIXED signal level.
neededObservations: actual tip temperature measured rather than inferred from battery voltage
cutting/embossing load and resulting groove width
surface noise and distortion on sacrificial playback rig
visible melting, charring, smoke, and material degradation; stop on any such indication

roles.CANNON: candidate integration receipts, not authorization to run machinery
